title: Synthetic statement (hawkish)
paragraphs: Inflation remains well above the Committee's 2 percent objective and price pressures have broadened.
The Committee anticipates that further increases in the target range will be appropriate.

title: Synthetic statement (balanced)
paragraphs: Economic activity has expanded at a moderate pace and inflation has eased toward 2 percent.
The Committee judges that the risks to achieving its goals are roughly in balance.

title: Synthetic statement (dovish)
paragraphs: Labor market conditions have weakened and the unemployment rate has moved up.
The Committee decided to lower the target range and is prepared to adjust policy further to support employment.
